name: okrm-design
description: A method for taking a design project from zero to one: position, question, key point, framework, object before layout, method, making with room for chance, production as negotiation, continuation, and one strange decision that follows from the content. Then form, in ubiquitous visual languages.

interface.displayName: OK-RM Design · 有意义的秩序
interface.shortDescription: From zero to one: a generation document before any layout.
interface.longDescription: The core deliverable is a generation document, not a layout: nine steps from positioning to continuation, plus one decision a conventional designer would reject that follows directly from the content. Thirty-four case paths record how books, identities, exhibitions and brand projects were conceived, from the first conversation to the printed object and its next edition; deviation operators are drawn from them. Form comes after: ubiquitous type, two poles of scale, one flat colour as material, measured starting values, an order-sheet generator and checker, and acceptance gates that test the path before the page. Distilled from a London studio's published interviews, publishing catalogue and work; contains none of its artwork and reproduces none of its layouts.
